title: Supplier risk report
intro: High-risk suppliers assessed before their first PO (KPI G-9), the suppliers by tier, pending assessments, suppliers past their cycle, overrides and registry flags. The figures come from the system, not from AI.
moduleOff: This organization has not switched on the supplier risk module, so this report is not available yet.

g9.title: High-risk suppliers assessed before their first PO (G-9)
g9.none: No high-risk supplier had its first PO in this period yet
g9.denominator: High-risk suppliers with their first PO in this period
g9.hint: Counts the suppliers whose first PO (cancelled POs aside) was sent in this period and passed the gate at high risk. A supplier let through by an override counts as not assessed. Rounded down to 2 decimals.
g9.caption: High-risk suppliers whose first PO was sent in this period, with what let the PO through
g9.emptyTitle: No high-risk supplier had its first PO in this period
g9.emptyHint: Try a longer period: each supplier has its first PO only once.

tiers.title: Suppliers by tier
tiers.intro: Active suppliers now, by their latest risk tier. Suppliers never assessed are apart from low risk.
tiers.caption: Suppliers by risk tier

pending.title: Pending assessments ({count})
pending.intro: Assessments open longer than the escalation time of supplier applications (business days), as of now, whatever the period.
pending.caption: Assessments open past their due time
pending.emptyHint: Assessments open past their due time show here.

overdue.title: Suppliers past their cycle ({count})
overdue.intro: Their latest assessment has expired and no new one is complete, as of today.
overdue.caption: Suppliers past their assessment cycle
overdue.emptyHint: Suppliers whose assessment has expired show here.

overrides.title: Risk gate overrides
overrides.summary: Open {open} · Expired {expired} · Used for a PO {used}
overrides.caption: Approved overrides with what they let out and who asked
overrides.emptyHint: Approved overrides show here with their POs and the amount used.

flagged.title: Suppliers with a registry flag ({count})
flagged.intro: Suppliers the registry reports as ceased, out of VAT or not found, as of now.
flagged.caption: Suppliers with a registry flag
flagged.emptyTitle: No supplier with a registry flag
flagged.emptyHint: Suppliers the registry reports an unusual status for show here.

export.title: Export
export.hint: An Excel file of the suppliers counted in G-9, for the same period and scope you see, with its checksum.
